rules.source_section: INDICATIONS / Peripheral Arterial Disease / Critical Limb Ischemia
rules.source_quote: For acute critical limb ischemia with any ONE of the below clinical signs of peripheral vascular disease: ○ Ischemic rest pain ○ Tissue loss ○ Gangrene
rules.clinical_service_or_procedure: CTA Abdominal Aorta with Lower Extremity Runoff

criteria.description: Suspected or known peripheral arterial disease with critical limb ischemia
At least one sign: ischemic rest pain, non-healing ischemic ulceration/tissue loss, or gangrene

required_documentation: Vascular surgery or podiatry exam documenting rest pain, tissue ulceration, or gangrene
rules.review_notes: Urgent critical limb ischemia bypasses conservative medical trial.
